single.help: Paste full prompt text (paragraphs and line breaks preserved as one prompt). Use "Number of Images per Prompt" below for multiples from this exact prompt.
single.placeholder:
Paste your complete prompt here, including paragraphs if needed. The entire text will be used as a single prompt for image generation.

Example: A detailed scene description with multiple sentences and line breaks all for one image concept...
single.note: Whole text = 1 prompt. Quantity duplicates it exactly for multiple images.

negative.label: Negative prompt
negative.unused: This model does not use a negative prompt.

anatomy.label: Enhance anatomy
anatomy.unusedTooltip: Not used here: this model reads the prompt as plain sentences, so anatomy tags would be drawn as scene content. Describe the pose in words instead.
anatomy.tooltip: Adds anatomy phrasing when the prompt is a person.
anatomy.unusedBoth: This model does not use a negative prompt or anatomy enhancement.
anatomy.unused: This model does not use anatomy enhancement.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.yourLoras: Your LoRAs (off until you turn one on):

enhance.label: Enhance prompts automatically
enhance.off: Off — prompts are sent as written.
enhance.prose: Rewrites each prompt into a fuller description with the chat model before rendering. If no chat model answers, the prompt goes as typed. Steps and guidance are not changed.
enhance.proseStyle: Rewrites each prompt into a fuller description with the chat model before rendering. If no chat model answers, the prompt goes as typed plus one sentence asking for the {{style}} look. Steps and guidance are not changed.
enhance.tagsNoNegative: Adds the content type’s quality and anatomy phrasing to each prompt. This model ignores negative prompts. Steps and guidance are not changed.
enhance.tags: Adds the content type’s quality and anatomy phrasing (and negatives) to each prompt. Steps and guidance are not changed.

guidance.zimageHelp: Z-Image runs CFG-free — guidance is fixed at 0. Use Steps for quality.
guidance.qwenHelp: Qwen-Image 2.1 runs at guidance 1 on the official path. Raise it only together with a negative prompt.
guidance.autoHelp: Auto routes per prompt. The usual pick (Z-Image) is CFG-free — keep 0 unless you expect an SDXL route.

seed.label: Seed
seed.fixed: The first image uses seed {{seed}}, each next image the next number. Same prompt and settings give the same picture.
seed.tooLarge: Seeds go up to {{max}}; this one is ignored.
seed.blank: Blank: every image gets its own random seed. Open an image and press the dice to reuse its seed.

gallery.title: Generated Images ({{count}})
gallery.rewritten: Rewritten before rendering; open to read it

lightbox.seedUsed: Seed {{seed}} is in the Seed box. Clear it to get random seeds again.
